title: India's investments in US treasuries up $38.4 billion in June-August
description:
India's investment in US Treasury securities increased USD 38.4 billion, or 21 per cent, between June and August, coinciding with substantial inflows of Foreign Currency Non-Resident (FCNR) (B) deposits into the Indian banking system.
According to data compiled by PTI from the US Department of the Treasury, India's investment in US Treasuries rose to USD 219.7 billion in August 2026 from USD 181.3 billion in May 2026, just before the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) introduced the concessional facility.
Gaura Sengupta, economist at IDFC First Bank, said the RBI's foreign exchange reserves increased during the period of FCNR(B) inflows, with a portion of the accretion being invested in US Treasury securities.
